about: Health V1a (docs/gameplay/survival_health_v1a.md 7): the medical alcohol's screw cap on its own, the cap part of the bottle's equipment mesh (item units as the bottle's: on the bottle it sits where the item has it). The player action item/alcohol_clean has it ride the bottle while screwed (turning about the bottle's axis), then the left hand carry it. Points (item block units): center, the cap's middle on the bottle's axis; top, its top; grip, where the left palm holds it, 2.05 px past its top along the axis (the hand's palm face on the cap's top).
